title: podman 5.8.7: copying an archive into a container fails with "path escapes from parent" when the path crosses an absolute symlink such as /var/run
body:
### Issue Description

Since 5.8.7, extracting an archive into a container fails when an entry's path passes through an absolute symlink inside the container filesystem. The common case is `/var/run -> /run`, which Debian and Ubuntu based images ship. The error is:

```
copying to container: statat var/run/<name>: path escapes from parent
```

This looks like a side effect of the CVE-2026-79705 fix in buildah/copier (GHSA-3528-5p26-cf44, buildah v1.43.4, pulled in by 5.8.7): path operations now run under a sandboxed root, which refuses to follow absolute symlinks even when the target is inside the container root.

`podman cp <file> ctr:/var/run/x` still works, because the CLI resolves the destination path inside the container before copying. Clients that send an archive with the path already in the entry names, extracted at `/`, do not get that resolution. The Docker-compatible `PUT /containers/{id}/archive` API is the main way this is hit: the Forgejo Actions runner (and act) copies every action into the job container this way under `/var/run/act/...`, so on podman 5.8.7 every job fails at checkout with the error above in the runner log:

```
failed to copy directory "/data/.cache/act/<hash>/" to container: Error response from daemon: statat var/run/act/actions/<hash>/.git: path escapes from parent
```

Docker had the same regression from its own os.Root hardening in 29.5.1 and fixed it in 29.5.2 by resolving in-container symlinks before the sandboxed operations: https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/52655 (see also https://code.forgejo.org/forgejo/runner/issues/1524 for the runner-side reports).

### Steps to reproduce the issue

```
podman run -d --rm --name t docker.io/library/node:26.9.0-trixie sleep 120
echo hi > /tmp/x
tar -C /tmp --transform 's,^x,var/run/x,' -cf - x | podman cp - t:/
```

For comparison, `podman cp /tmp/x t:/var/run/x` succeeds on the same container, and an image where `/var/run` is a relative symlink (`node:26.9.0-alpine` has `/var/run -> ../run`) is not affected.


### Describe the results you received

```
Error: 1 error occurred:
        * copying to container: statat var/run/x: path escapes from parent
```

Same result rootless (above) and rootful via the API socket (Forgejo runner)

### Describe the results you expected

The file lands in `/run/x` inside the container, as it did on 5.8.4. Absolute symlinks whose target stays inside the container root should be followed; only escapes from the container root should be rejected.

### Podman in a container

No

### Privileged Or Rootless

Rootless

### Upstream Latest Release

Yes

### Additional environment details

Fedora bootc 44 (fedora-bootc:44 base). podman 5.8.4-1.fc44 with buildah 1.43.2 works; podman 5.8.7-1.fc44 with buildah 1.43.4 fails. The Fedora rebuild of the same image with the newer podman is the only change between the two.
